_comments.llm_model: Chat model used for room and task generation.
_comments.task_count: Number of independent human motion sequences per room.
_comments.agent_radius: Clearance radius used by the path planner, in metres.
_comments.in_place_path_length_m: Short conditioning path length for in-place actions, in metres.
_comments.seed: Initial random seed; retries use different seeds.
_comments.categorical: true samples motion tokens; false selects the most likely token.
_comments.smpl_iterations: Number of SMPL fitting optimization iterations.
_comments.holodeck_python / motion_python / mesh_p: Optional interpreter paths for each stage; null uses the current interpreter.

motion_safety.enabled: Check joints and fitted meshes, try small placement repairs, then regenerate human tasks and motions in the same room if needed.
motion_safety.clearance_m: Extra clearance around the body, in metres.
motion_safety.contact_tolerance_m: Overlap depth above which a frame counts as colliding, in metres.
motion_safety.max_penetration_m: Maximum allowed overlap with conservative scene collision bounds, in metres.
motion_safety.max_collision_frame_fraction: Maximum fraction of frames allowed above the contact tolerance; range 0 to 1.
motion_safety.max_shift_m: Maximum total horizontal placement adjustment per motion, including diagonal shifts, in metres.
motion_safety.shift_step_m: Spacing between candidate placement adjustments, in metres.
motion_safety.floor_tolerance_m: Allowed floor penetration before collision thresholds apply, in metres.
motion_safety.max_locomotion_foot_height_m: Height above which both feet count as airborne during grounded locomotion, in metres.
motion_safety.max_locomotion_air_time_s: Maximum consecutive airborne time during grounded locomotion, in seconds; jumping is excluded.
motion_safety.min_spin_rotation_degrees: Minimum body rotation required for actions described as spins.
motion_safety.max_attempts: Total attempts, including the first. Retries need the API key. Set to 1 for offline runs with supplied tasks; exhaustion reports Motion generation failed.

radio_materials.material_column: Saved assignment column: extended_mat or builtin_mat.
radio_materials.object_overrides: Optional mapping from exported shape IDs to RF material names.
